scope: All ordinary body-flow citations, their nearby claims, all canonical publication source files, bibliography coverage, final aux/bbl/blg consistency, and the absence of unsupported strengthening were checked against the frozen manuscript and primary publication records.
citation_audit_method: Two-pass citation-check workflow: frozen claim extraction followed by sequential primary-source web verification, full-text source locators, active user-library binding, official publication-metadata comparison, and final BibTeX/build-log consistency checks.
